metadata.title: Trifluridine and Tipiracil (Lonsurf®) Therapy
metadata.indication: Previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer; 35 mg/m² twice daily on days 1–5 and 8–12 every 28 days.

validation.review_status: Source reconciled; independent clinical and pharmacy review pending

metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.
encoding_maturity.review_status: Source reconciled; independent clinical and pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Official current NCCP PDF retrieved via the HSE index and critical tables visually checked
metadata.source_version_change: NCCP v3 to v4, reviewed 01/07/2026; stable legacy protocol_id retained for compatibility.
metadata.indication_summary: 00382a: previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer monotherapy. The separate EMA gastric monotherapy and colorectal plus bevacizumab indications are not encoded by this NCCP regimen.
metadata.schedule_summary: Take the prescribed morning and evening tablets on Days 1–5, have no Lonsurf on Days 6–7, then take morning and evening tablets on Days 8–12. Days 13–28 are tablet-free. A new 28-day cycle starts only when the team authorises it.

source_supplements.label: EMA Lonsurf product information and patient leaflet
source_supplements.basis: Audited product information supplement; NCCP differences remain explicit

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Source reconciliation for v0.84.24 is not clinical authorisation. Confirm the current NCCP document, product information, clinical context and independent oncology/pharmacy review.

indications.description: Adults with metastatic colorectal cancer previously treated with, or unsuitable for, available fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, irinotecan-, anti-VEGF- and anti-EGFR-based therapies.

dose.unit: mg/m² per dose twice daily; trifluridine component; maximum 80 mg per dose

administration.note: Within 1 hour after morning and evening meals. Days 6–7 and 13–28 are tablet-free. Use the BSA tablet table, including unequal AM/PM doses at 50 mg total daily. Do not make up missed or held doses.

output_templates.contraindicated: The entered data trigger a protocol exclusion or contraindication pathway.
output_templates.discontinue: The entered data trigger protocol discontinuation.
output_templates.withhold: Hold treatment and follow the protocol reassessment pathway.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant review is required before treatment proceeds.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Treatment may proceed only after the encoded component modifications are reviewed and prescribed.
output_templates.proceed: No encoded dose-modification criterion was triggered by the entered data.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive overall action; combine component changes using the greatest reduction per component rather than summing reductions.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: All inputs optional. Missing assessment timing, nadir/delay, dose history or renal context remains unknown. Never issue general treatment clearance from isolated values.

action.recommendation: Do not administer trifluridine/tipiracil for relevant hypersensitivity.

rules.explanation: Do not administer trifluridine/tipiracil for relevant hypersensitivity.

action.recommendation: Do not use the routine NCCP pathway in pregnancy or breastfeeding; urgent specialist discussion and cessation of breastfeeding are required.

rules.explanation: Do not use the routine NCCP pathway in pregnancy or breastfeeding; urgent specialist discussion and cessation of breastfeeding are required.

action.recommendation: 00382a is colorectal monotherapy. Gastric monotherapy and colorectal treatment with bevacizumab have separate licensed/evidence contexts; confirm the correct protocol, reimbursement and additional safety plan.

rules.explanation: 00382a is colorectal monotherapy. Gastric monotherapy and colorectal treatment with bevacizumab have separate licensed/evidence contexts; confirm the correct protocol, reimbursement and additional safety plan.

action.recommendation: NCCP eligibility is ECOG 0–1; reassess suitability outside this range.

rules.explanation: NCCP eligibility is ECOG 0–1; reassess suitability outside this range.

action.recommendation: Interrupt oral dosing for ANC <0.5 ×10⁹/L; check infection and recovery. A new cycle requires ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Interrupt oral dosing for ANC <0.5 ×10⁹/L; check infection and recovery. A new cycle requires ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Interrupt oral dosing for platelets <50 ×10⁹/L; a new cycle requires platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Interrupt oral dosing for platelets <50 ×10⁹/L; a new cycle requires platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: ANC 0.5 to <1.5 ×10⁹/L: the new-cycle threshold differs from the on-treatment interruption threshold. Confirm timing; this isolated value does not authorise treatment or restart.

rules.explanation: ANC 0.5 to <1.5 ×10⁹/L: the new-cycle threshold differs from the on-treatment interruption threshold. Confirm timing; this isolated value does not authorise treatment or restart.

action.recommendation: Do not start a new cycle or restart without recovery review: ANC 0.5 to <1.5 ×10⁹/L. New-cycle minima are ANC 1.5 and platelets 75 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Do not start a new cycle or restart without recovery review: ANC 0.5 to <1.5 ×10⁹/L. New-cycle minima are ANC 1.5 and platelets 75 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: platelets 50 to <75 ×10⁹/L: the new-cycle threshold differs from the on-treatment interruption threshold. Confirm timing; this isolated value does not authorise treatment or restart.

rules.explanation: platelets 50 to <75 ×10⁹/L: the new-cycle threshold differs from the on-treatment interruption threshold. Confirm timing; this isolated value does not authorise treatment or restart.

action.recommendation: Do not start a new cycle or restart without recovery review: platelets 50 to <75 ×10⁹/L. New-cycle minima are ANC 1.5 and platelets 75 ×10⁹/L.

rules.explanation: Do not start a new cycle or restart without recovery review: platelets 50 to <75 ×10⁹/L. New-cycle minima are ANC 1.5 and platelets 75 ×10⁹/L.

action.recommendation: Interrupt, urgently manage febrile neutropenia, and wait for recovery to grade 1/baseline plus next-cycle counts. On authorised resumption reduce the previous dose by 5 mg/m² per dose; respect the renal-specific minimum and never re-escalate.

rules.explanation: Interrupt, urgently manage febrile neutropenia, and wait for recovery to grade 1/baseline plus next-cycle counts. On authorised resumption reduce the previous dose by 5 mg/m² per dose; respect the renal-specific minimum and never re-escalate.

action.recommendation: Urgently assess/treat infection and review blood counts. Infection alone does not prove the prior febrile-neutropenia dose-reduction criterion.

rules.explanation: Urgently assess/treat infection and review blood counts. Infection alone does not prove the prior febrile-neutropenia dose-reduction criterion.

action.recommendation: Prior ANC <0.5 or platelets <25 ×10⁹/L: establish the resulting next-cycle delay. The source dose reduction requires more than 7 days of delay, not the low nadir alone.

rules.explanation: Prior ANC <0.5 or platelets <25 ×10⁹/L: establish the resulting next-cycle delay. The source dose reduction requires more than 7 days of delay, not the low nadir alone.

action.recommendation: After count recovery and Consultant review reduce by 5 mg/m² per dose because the severe nadir caused >7 days of next-cycle delay; do not add separate reductions for coexisting toxicities.

rules.explanation: After count recovery and Consultant review reduce by 5 mg/m² per dose because the severe nadir caused >7 days of next-cycle delay; do not add separate reductions for coexisting toxicities.

action.recommendation: For the clinician-confirmed qualifying grade 3–4 non-haematological event, interrupt to grade 1/baseline then reduce by 5 mg/m² per dose. Respect exceptions, prior dose and renal-specific minimum; no re-escalation.

rules.explanation: For the clinician-confirmed qualifying grade 3–4 non-haematological event, interrupt to grade 1/baseline then reduce by 5 mg/m² per dose. Respect exceptions, prior dose and renal-specific minimum; no re-escalation.

action.recommendation: Assess severe non-haematological toxicity urgently and identify the event and treatment response. Source exceptions for controlled grade-3 GI toxicity do not establish general fitness to treat.

rules.explanation: Assess severe non-haematological toxicity urgently and identify the event and treatment response. Source exceptions for controlled grade-3 GI toxicity do not establish general fitness to treat.

action.recommendation: Interrupt qualifying non-haematological toxicity until grade 1/baseline; then Consultant-directed 5 mg/m² per-dose reduction. Grade-3 nausea/vomiting controlled by antiemetics or responsive diarrhoea is excepted; grade-4 symptoms require urgent review.

rules.explanation: Interrupt qualifying non-haematological toxicity until grade 1/baseline; then Consultant-directed 5 mg/m² per-dose reduction. Grade-3 nausea/vomiting controlled by antiemetics or responsive diarrhoea is excepted; grade-4 symptoms require urgent review.

action.recommendation: Do not initiate with unresolved grade 3–4 clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity from previous therapy.

rules.explanation: Do not initiate with unresolved grade 3–4 clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity from previous therapy.

action.recommendation: Severe renal impairment (CrCl 15 to <30): source starting level 20 mg/m² twice daily, with one permitted reduction to 15 mg/m² twice daily if needed. Confirm previous dose and use the BSA tablet table; this is not an automatic restart or escalation.

rules.explanation: Severe renal impairment (CrCl 15 to <30): source starting level 20 mg/m² twice daily, with one permitted reduction to 15 mg/m² twice daily if needed. Confirm previous dose and use the BSA tablet table; this is not an automatic restart or escalation.

action.recommendation: Administration is not recommended for CrCl <15 mL/min or dialysis; do not extrapolate the NCCP <30 row below the product-label studied range. Obtain specialist review.

rules.explanation: Administration is not recommended for CrCl <15 mL/min or dialysis; do not extrapolate the NCCP <30 row below the product-label studied range. Obtain specialist review.

action.recommendation: Moderate/severe renal impairment increases toxicity risk: arrange more frequent haematological monitoring; CrCl ≥30 alone does not require a reduced starting dose.

rules.explanation: Moderate/severe renal impairment increases toxicity risk: arrange more frequent haematological monitoring; CrCl ≥30 alone does not require a reduced starting dose.

action.recommendation: Not recommended in baseline moderate/severe hepatic impairment (SmPC NCI total bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN). Confirm baseline classification and specialist plan rather than calculate a dose.

rules.explanation: Not recommended in baseline moderate/severe hepatic impairment (SmPC NCI total bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN). Confirm baseline classification and specialist plan rather than calculate a dose.

action.recommendation: A further reduction at 20 or 15 mg/m² requires reconciliation of renal category and prior reductions. Standard minimum is 20; severe-renal minimum 15. Do not calculate a lower dose, restart automatically or multiply reductions.

rules.explanation: A further reduction at 20 or 15 mg/m² requires reconciliation of renal category and prior reductions. Standard minimum is 20; severe-renal minimum 15. Do not calculate a lower dose, restart automatically or multiply reductions.

action.recommendation: Reconcile the exact AM/PM tablet quantities and dosing/rest days. Do not replace missed, held or vomited doses; use the next scheduled prescribed dose after advice.

rules.explanation: Reconcile the exact AM/PM tablet quantities and dosing/rest days. Do not replace missed, held or vomited doses; use the next scheduled prescribed dose after advice.

toxicity_requiring_interruption.label: Grade 3–4 non-haematological toxicity requiring interruption
toxicity_requiring_interruption.assessment_guidance: Legacy clinician-confirmed grade 3–4 non-haematological event requiring interruption, after considering source GI exceptions. This positive flag cannot be cancelled by a discordant new grade.

crcl_ml_min.label: Legacy creatinine clearance band (optional compatibility input)

options.label: Dialysis - use the protocol-specific dialysis pathway / specialist review

crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Preserved legacy categories; numeric input is preferred. Do not treat CrCl, eGFR and measured GFR as interchangeable. If exact and band inputs conflict, restrictive findings remain and require reconciliation.

options.label: 15 mg/m² twice daily (severe renal impairment minimum)

renal_input.reason: The product label distinguishes <15, 15 to <30 and ≥30 mL/min; retain decimals at the boundaries.

nonhaem_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: Use the named toxicity and source grading; do not substitute CTCAE v5.0 descriptions.
nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Document the named adverse event and apply the cited source severity criterion; grade 0 means explicitly absent, not unknown.

gi_toxicity_controlled.label: Grade-3 nausea/vomiting controlled by antiemetics or diarrhoea responding to antidiarrhoeals

oral_schedule_uncertain.label: Missed doses, vomiting, adherence or tablet schedule needs reconciliation

notes: Oral moderate-to-high emetogenic risk per NCCP v4 p5; use an individual oral antiemetic plan, not automatic parenteral multi-drug chemotherapy prophylaxis.
No routine premedication specified. More frequent blood-count monitoring in moderate/severe renal impairment.

Women: highly effective contraception during and 6 months after; add barrier protection to hormonal methods. Men with partners of childbearing potential: effective contraception during and 6 months after.
Do not make up missed, held or vomited doses; take within 1 hour after morning/evening meals on prescribed dosing days only.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00382 v4 p5 oral classification; oral guidance V6 rather than parenteral NCIS regimen.
